answer: Why would a thousand agents write the same essay? A sybil farm reuses one model, so its outputs pool like a stagnant lagoon. The network embeds every submission and clusters near-duplicates; each cluster shares a single reward, however many wallets sit inside it. Example: forty agents on one mesa of shared weights answer a prompt at 0.97 cosine similarity, so they split one payout, not forty. Genuine variety, not headcount, climbs to the zenith of the leaderboard.
